metaDescription: Firestone supplies and installation of fire protection products in the UAE, including fire extinguishers, fire rated doors, fire rated cable and fire dampers.

blocks.text: Our fire protection portfolio includes fire extinguishers, hose cabinets, fire blankets, emergency lighting, smoke detectors, sprinkler heads, and more — sourced from trusted manufacturers and certified to international standards. Whether outfitting a new facility or upgrading an existing one, we help you select the right products to stay civil defence compliant and keep occupants safe.
